svg.title: Job expansion: the loop in Plan(), step by step
svg.desc: Three pending jobs. Each row shows the code that runs for one loop iteration and the three containers after it. One job can create several events; all of them carry that job's index.
svg.metadata: ["Before the loop: Plan() builds ctx from the validated request_data.base_state. scheduled_jobs and the event DAG are empty; three jobs are pending.", "i = 0, RETRIEVE: Plan() copies *ctx, then ExpandJob() takes job_index = scheduled_jobs.size() = 0. ExpandRetrieveJob succeeds and adds four events to ctx->event_dag, every one constructed with job_index 0.", "Plan() appends the RETRIEVE to ctx->scheduled_jobs (AddScheduledJob), so it now sits at [0], the slot its four events point to.", "i = 1, INSERT: job_index = size() = 1. ExpandInsertJob fails (the bay has no tray in a discrete state). Plan() restores *ctx from the copy, so scheduled_jobs and the DAG are as they were, even for a job that fails after adding events.", "The failure goes straight into response.scheduled_jobs as MakeFailedJob(job, message, is_retryable) with STATE_ERROR, and only for INSERT Plan() also fires clean_garage_request_fn_().", "i = 2, REPARK_TRAY: job_index = size() is 1 again, because the INSERT never got a slot. ExpandReparkTrayJob adds one event with job_index 1.", "The REPARK_TRAY is appended at [1], matching its event's job_index. With i (= 2) the event would point past the end of scheduled_jobs.", "After the loop, the index stays on everything that belongs to the job: job [0] -> its four events after expansion.", "Tray and AGV assignment add blocker TrayMoves and AgvMoves with the same job_index; BuildActionGraph() turns each motion into an ActionNode with scheduled_jobs[job_index].job.guid.", "The final result: failures first in loop order, then the successful jobs with their node_indices. And the reason the index is size(), not i."]

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Later stages keep the tag: a blocker TrayMove is built as MakeTrayMove(move->GetJobIndex(), ...) and an AGV approach as MakeAgvPoseMove(root_event->GetJobIndex(), ...), so they belong to the job whose

g.text: Final response.scheduled_jobs = [INSERT STATE_ERROR, RETRIEVE STATE_EXECUTING, REPARK_TRAY STATE_EXECUTING]: failures first, in loop order, then successes in request order with their node_indices.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Why size() and not i: the index must point into scheduled_jobs, which only holds successful jobs. With i, the REPARK's event would say 2, and scheduled_jobs[2] does not exist.

g.text: job_index is the job's position in ctx->scheduled_jobs (jobs that have succeeded so far), not its position in the request (i). A job usually creates several events; every one of them is

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: constructed with the same job_index, and so are the events later stages add for that job. A job that fails leaves no events: Plan() restores the context it copied before the job.
